summary_points: Performance test procedure for centrifugal pumps according to ISO 9906.
Tests conducted on manufacturer's test stand using cold water.
Pumps tested with calibrated test motor and torque bar.
Records of tests must be kept for at least 10 years.
Sound pressure level test procedure defined for centrifugal pumps.
Bearing temperature test procedure for centrifugal pumps with specific conditions and measurements.
Running test procedure including capacity, suction head, discharge head, speed, and power measurements.
Impeller balancing using a rotational-balancing-machine according to DIN ISO 1940 T1.
Liquid visible penetrant examination (PT) procedure according to ASME Sec. V, Article 6.
Procedure for liquid visible penetrant examination according to ASME Sec. V, Article 6
Purpose is to locate flaws on components like sand die castings, semi-finished products, tubes, etc.
Normative references include ASNT SNT-TC-1A, DIN EN ISO 9712, and other international standards
Personnel must be qualified in level II of PT according to ASNT or DIN EN ISO 9712
Safety requirements mandate adequate ventilation and separation from ignition sources
Pentrant system must be water or solvent removable and approved by ISO 3452-1
Preferential penetrants are from Chemetal, including ARDROX 9PR88, 9VF2, and 9D1 B
Procedure for Liquid Visible Penetrant Examination (PT) according to ASME Sec. V, Article 6.
Test devices include UV-meter and reference blocks with specific calibration requirements.
Surface preparation involves cleaning parts with solvent-based cleaners and drying before applying penetrant.
Penetrant application is done by spraying or brushing; dwell time ranges from 10 to 30 minutes.
Developer must be applied uniformly, and indications are evaluated based on color contrast.
Test results must be documented in a report that includes part details, penetration system, and personnel information.
Paint coat application procedure for RHEINHÜTTE Pumpen GmbH.
First coat: Abrasive blasting, spray gun, and dust dry after 24 hours.
Top coat: Intact, dry surface required; spray gun, and dust dry after 24 hours.
Layer thicknesses: First, intermediate, and top coats each 125-150µm, total 375-450µm.
Defects must be repaired before applying further coats.
Temperature range for operation: > 500 °C; application: ambient to 260 °C.
